comment: Two disagreements with the README. First, Blender.cpp:172 reads (input1 * (1 - mix)) + (input2 * mix) * vol, so the master volume multiplies only the IN2 term; the README says it is a master volume up to 200%. Second, the README says MOD2 modulates the MOD attenuverter, but at :140 and :142 the MOD2 result is simply added alongside the MOD result, and at :124 the entire modulation branch is skipped unless MOD itself is connected, so MOD2 alone does nothing. Blender.cpp:146-149 also replaces a negative blend with its absolute value, and the clamp at :148 is unreachable because the value has already been made positive. Left and right take their channel counts independently, from IN1 L and IN1 R.
